# Elstad Array in the news

Weather data from a nearby station is used to forecast charging opportunities a day ahead. Grid operators value storage that can shift energy from midday surpluses to the evening peak. A community fund receives a small share of the revenue from frequency regulation services. Several neighbouring utilities have signed agreements to buy capacity during winter peaks. The battery hall is divided into fire compartments, each with its own ventilation path.

Researchers caution against reading too much into a single season of operating data. Noise from the cooling fans stays below the limits agreed with the neighbouring village. The plant can black-start a nearby gas turbine, which the grid operator tests twice a year. Permitting took longer than the construction itself, a pattern seen at several sites in the region. Data from the site feeds a public dashboard that shows charging and discharging in real time.
